## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Hēdiāo Ānáhán jīng* (T538) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by Zhú Tánwúlán 竺曇無蘭 ([竺曇無蘭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%98%AD)). The names *Hēdiāo* 呵雕 and *Ānáhán* 阿那鋡 are phonetic transliterations.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna*-style narrative. Translation dated to Tánwúlán's Eastern Jìn period (381–395 CE).
